data.medical_history: Chronic essential hypertension diagnosed 2020. Mild right knee osteoarthritis.
Recurrent migraine headaches with visual aura. Seasonal allergic rhinitis.
Childhood bronchial asthma diagnosed at age 4. Mild eczema.
Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (managed). Total knee replacement left knee (2022).
No chronic systemic illness. Uncomplicated appendectomy in 2018.
Hypothyroidism on Eltroxin therapy. Cervical spondylosis with radiculopathy.
Coronary Artery Bypass Graft (CABG) in 2021. Mixed dyslipidemia. Mild peripheral edema.
Recurrent episodes of acute streptococcal tonsillitis. Completed antibiotic course.

data.chief_complaint: Exertional chest tightness and shortness of breath upon climbing stairs
data.diagnosis: Stable Angina Pectoris, Grade II Essential Hypertension
data.treatment: Initiated Beta-blocker (Metoprolol) and ACE inhibitor (Ramipril). Ordered lipid panel and ECG.
data.notes: Patient advised on low-sodium diet and stress reduction. Follow-up scheduled in 4 weeks.

data.chief_complaint: Persistent right knee joint pain and morning stiffness
data.treatment: Prescribed oral NSAID short-course, topical analgesic gel, and quadriceps strengthening physiotherapy.
data.notes: X-ray confirmed mild joint space narrowing. Avoid high-impact jogging.

data.chief_complaint: Severe pulsating unilateral left-sided headache with photophobia and nausea for 2 days
data.diagnosis: Acute Migraine Attack with Visual Aura
data.treatment: Administered oral Sumatriptan 50mg, IV hydration fluids, and prescribed abortive triptan regimen.
data.notes: Neurological examination cranial nerves intact. Advised keeping a headache trigger diary.
